The '''Retro League''' (also '''Retro GEMP League''' and '''SWCCG Online Retro League''') is an annual league run by the [[Players Committee]] on [[GEMP]]. Each season is a series of six-game events in older, Premiere-based formats. In 2022 and 2023 the champion was the player with the highest cumulative score. Since 2024 the champion is decided by the [[Retro Online Championship Series]] (ROCS), a playoff for the top 8. The first season was in 2022.<ref name="pc2023" /> The [[2021 Retro Event (Premiere to Death Star II)|2021 Retro Event]] was a separate, earlier event on GEMP.

== Format ==
* '''Events:''' six games of Swiss, one game per week, ranked by strength of schedule.<ref name="t80048" /><ref name="t84002" />
* '''Play:''' players get an assigned opponent and play on GEMP with 45-minute timers per side.<ref name="t80296" />
* '''Cumulative standings:''' 3 points per win and 1 per loss, plus 4 bonus points for first and 2 for second in an event.<ref name="t84316" />
* '''Fee:''' 2022 was free. From 2023, a flat \$10 covers the whole season.<ref name="pc2023" /><ref name="t86346" />
